table_result.name: //bigquery.googleapis.com/projects/royston-dev-8253/datasets/cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy/tables/balance_snapshots
table_result.overview: This table stores historical financial information for various accounts. It provides a monthly record of financial holdings. This data supports analysis of account value trends over time. It is used for tracking financial performance and changes in account status.

fields.name: snapshot_month
fields.description: This column holds the specific month for which the account balance was recorded.

fields.name: balance
fields.description: This column holds the recorded financial amount for the account at the specified month.

fields.name: account_id
fields.description: This column holds a unique identifier for each individual account.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  t1.account_id,
  t1.snapshot_month,
  t1.balance AS current_month_balance,
  t2.balance AS previous_month_balance,
  (t1.balance - t2.balance) AS balance_drop,
  (t1.balance - t2.balance) / t2.balance AS percentage_drop
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots` AS t1
JOIN `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots` AS t2
  ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
  AND t1.snapshot_month = DATE_ADD(t2.snapshot_month, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
WHERE t2.balance > 1000
  AND (t1.balance - t2.balance) / t2.balance < -0.5
ORDER BY t1.account_id, t1.snapshot_month;
queries.description: Identify accounts that have experienced a sudden and significant drop in balance, defined as a decrease of more than 50% from the previous month's balance, and where the previous month's balance was above a certain threshold (e.g., 1000).

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  CORR(balance, UNIX_DATE(snapshot_month)) AS balance_time_correlation
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
GROUP BY
  account_id;
queries.description: Calculate the correlation between an account's balance and its snapshot month (represented as a numerical value) to understand if there's a linear relationship between time and balance changes for each account.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      snapshot_month,
      balance,
      LAG(balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_balance_1,
      LAG(balance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_balance_2
    FROM
      `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
    WHERE
      snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  )
  WHERE
    balance < prev_balance_1
    AND prev_balance_1 < prev_balance_2
  GROUP BY
    account_id
  HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 1;
queries.description: Identify accounts where the balance has consistently decreased for three consecutive months.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    balance,
    LAG(balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS previous_month_balance
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  QUALIFY
    balance > (LAG(balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) * 1.20)
  ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Identify accounts whose balance has increased by more than 20% in any given month compared to the previous month.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    AVG(balance) AS average_monthly_balance,
    (AVG(balance) - LAG(AVG(balance), 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month)) / LAG(AVG(balance), 1, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) * 100 AS percentage_change_from_previous_month
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    account_id, snapshot_month
  ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Calculate the average monthly balance for each account, showing the percentage change from the previous month's average balance.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      snapshot_month,
      balance,
      LAG(balance, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_month_balance,
      LAG(balance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS prev_2_month_balance
    FROM
      `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  )
WHERE
  balance > prev_month_balance AND prev_month_balance > prev_2_month_balance
GROUP BY
  account_id
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT snapshot_month) >= 3;
queries.description: Identify accounts where the balance has consistently increased over the last three recorded months, indicating a positive trend.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    balance,
    LAG(balance, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS previous_month_balance,
    balance - LAG(balance, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS monthly_balance_change
FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Calculate the month-over-month balance change for each account and identify accounts with significant fluctuations.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    MAX(balance) AS max_balance,
    ARRAY_AGG(snapshot_month ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS month_of_max_balance,
    MIN(balance) AS min_balance,
    ARRAY_AGG(snapshot_month ORDER BY balance ASC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS month_of_min_balance
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    account_id
  ORDER BY
    account_id;
queries.description: For each account, find the maximum balance recorded and the month it occurred, along with the minimum balance and its corresponding month, to understand the range and timing of balance fluctuations.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  snapshot_month,
  AVG(balance) AS average_balance,
  (AVG(balance) - LAG(AVG(balance), 1) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_month)) / LAG(AVG(balance), 1) OVER (ORDER BY snapshot_month) * 100 AS mom_percentage_change
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
GROUP BY
  snapshot_month
ORDER BY
  snapshot_month;
queries.description: Calculate the month-over-month percentage change in the average balance across all accounts, highlighting periods of significant growth or decline.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    balance,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY snapshot_month ORDER BY balance) AS balance_percent_rank
FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY
    snapshot_month, balance_percent_rank DESC;
queries.description: Calculate the percentile rank of each account's balance within its respective snapshot month, indicating its relative standing.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      COUNTIF(balance > 1000) AS months_above_threshold,
      COUNT(snapshot_month) AS total_months
    FROM
      `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
    WHERE
      snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
    GROUP BY
      account_id
  )
  WHERE
    months_above_threshold >= 0.75 * total_months
  ORDER BY
    account_id;
queries.description: Identify accounts that have maintained a balance above a certain threshold (e.g., 1000) for at least 75% of the recorded months.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    snapshot_month,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(balance, 100)[OFFSET(90)] AS ninety_percentile_balance
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    snapshot_month
  ORDER BY
    snapshot_month;
queries.description: For each month, determine the 90th percentile balance across all accounts, indicating the balance level of the top 10% of accounts.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    balance,
    SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS cumulative_balance
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Calculate the cumulative sum of balances for each account over time, showing the running total.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  t1.account_id,
  t1.max_balance,
  t2.snapshot_month AS month_of_max_balance,
  t1.min_balance,
  (t1.max_balance - t1.min_balance) AS balance_range
FROM
  (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      MAX(balance) AS max_balance,
      MIN(balance) AS min_balance
    FROM
      `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
    GROUP BY
      account_id
  ) AS t1
JOIN
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots` AS t2
ON
  t1.account_id = t2.account_id AND t1.max_balance = t2.balance;
queries.description: For each account, find the maximum monthly balance, the minimum monthly balance, and the range (max - min) of balances, along with the month in which the maximum balance occurred.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    AVG(balance) AS average_balance_last_6_months
  FROM (
    SELECT
      account_id,
      balance,
      snapshot_month,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC) AS rn
    FROM
      `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
    WHERE
      snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  )
  WHERE
    rn <= 6
  GROUP BY
    account_id
  ORDER BY
    account_id;
queries.description: Calculate the average balance for each account, but only considering the last 6 months of available data, to focus on recent trends.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM snapshot_month) AS snapshot_year,
    MAX(balance) AS max_yearly_balance,
    ARRAY_AGG(snapshot_month ORDER BY balance DESC LIMIT 1)[OFFSET(0)] AS month_of_max_balance
FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 5 YEAR) AND CURRENT_DATE()
GROUP BY
    account_id, snapshot_year
ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_year;
queries.description: Identify the maximum balance achieved by each account within each calendar year.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    snapshot_month,
    APPROX_QUANTILES(balance, 2)[OFFSET(1)] AS median_balance
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    snapshot_month
  ORDER BY
    snapshot_month;
queries.description: Find the median balance for each month across all accounts.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    FIRST_VALUE(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS first_recorded_balance,
    LAST_VALUE(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_recorded_balance,
    FIRST_VALUE(snapshot_month) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month) AS first_balance_date,
    LAST_VALUE(snapshot_month) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_balance_date,
    DATE_DIFF(LAST_VALUE(snapshot_month) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING), FIRST_VALUE(snapshot_month) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month), MONTH) AS duration_in_months
FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR) AND CURRENT_DATE()
QUALIFY
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month DESC) = 1
ORDER BY
    account_id;
queries.description: Find the first and last recorded balance for each account and the duration between these snapshots.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    STDDEV(balance) AS balance_std_dev
  FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
  WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2023-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    account_id
  ORDER BY
    balance_std_dev DESC
  LIMIT 5;
queries.description: Determine the top 5 accounts with the highest standard deviation in their monthly balances over the last year, indicating volatile accounts.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  (STDDEV_SAMP(balance) / AVG(balance)) AS coefficient_of_variation
FROM
  `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
GROUP BY
  account_id
HAVING
  AVG(balance) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(balance) <> 0
ORDER BY
  coefficient_of_variation DESC
LIMIT 10;
queries.description: Determine the coefficient of variation (standard deviation divided by the mean) for each account's balance over time, indicating the relative variability of balances, and identify accounts with the highest relative variability.

queries.sql:
SELECT
    account_id,
    snapshot_month,
    balance,
    AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS three_month_moving_avg_balance
FROM
    `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
WHERE
    snapshot_month BETWEEN DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR) AND CURRENT_DATE()
ORDER BY
    account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Determine the average balance for each account over the last three months, providing a smoothed trend.

queries.sql:
SELECT
  account_id,
  snapshot_month,
  STDDEV(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS six_month_stddev_balance
FROM `royston-dev-8253.cymbal_bank_v6z_scaffold_demo_copy.balance_snapshots`
QUALIFY STDDEV(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY snapshot_month ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) < 10
ORDER BY account_id, snapshot_month;
queries.description: Detect accounts whose balance has remained unusually stagnant over a 6-month period, defined as the standard deviation of their monthly balances being below a very low threshold (e.g., 10).
